description: Airport lounges for a journey: the lounges at each airport (origin, connections, destination) and which ones the traveler can use with their cards, plus access rules by ticket and status (business class, oneworld/Star Alliance/SkyTeam elite). Covers 214 airports, including Brussels and the main European and Asian hubs, with access by ticket, status, Priority Pass and cards by issuing country. Use it when planning the full journey, after the flights are decided or when the traveler asks about lounges. Card rules change often; the data has an as_of date and verified flags.

airports.description: IATA codes in travel order, e.g. ["SFO","SEA","HND"]

cards.description: Lounge-relevant cards the traveler holds, as slugs. US-issued: amex_platinum, amex_business_platinum, amex_centurion_card, chase_sapphire_reserve, capital_one_venture_x, citi_strata_elite, citi_aadvantage_executive, united_club_infinite, delta_reserve, bilt_palladium, priority_pass_network. Issued elsewhere: amex_platinum_be, amex_platinum_uk, amex_platinum_de, amex_platinum_nl, amex_platinum_fr, amex_platinum_au, revolut_ultra_be, bnp_fortis_mc_world_elite, belfius_private_mc_world_elite. Ask where a card was issued if it matters. Empty if unknown.
